evidence.expiry: 『All of our Mexican airport concessions have a term of 50 years commencing on November 1, 1998. Under certain circumstances, the SICT may extend these concessions』→メキシコ全空港が2048年頃満了・残り約22年。ジャマイカMBJは『the concession term was extended to 31 years...scheduled to expire in March 2034』。『Upon expiration or termination of the concession term, all airport assets...will automatically revert to the AAJ without additional』=満了時資産返還の期限型独占
evidence.dom: 『All of our Mexican airport concessions have a term of 50 years』=各空港が単一事業者への50年排他コンセッション=商圏内地域独占。ASR/OMABと同型のメキシコ空港民営化構造でカバー圏≥90%=100
evidence.irr_rep: 『the SICT awarded several airport concessions to state-owned companies in which the Mexican military holds the majority interest』(2023Q4-2024Q1)=国家/軍による新規供給が現実化→唯一供給(100)とは言えずirr85(認証・規格ロック)/rep80(極困難だが国家が複製可)。『We also expect competitive pressures to intensify if the Mexican or Jamaican government grant new concessions』
evidence.dur: 規制(50年コンセッション)+物理(滑走路・ターミナル)=100。空港インフラの複製困難性
evidence.erosion: 『the SICT awarded several airport concessions to state-owned companies in which the Mexican military holds the majority interest』+『competitive pressures to intensify if...government grant new concessions』+FBOで第三者競合(Primeskyシェア38.3→42.8%は防衛的)=新興の蝕(emerging)。ただしコア50年独占は維持
evidence.moatdecay: コア空港の50年独占コンセッションと支配的地位は維持=no。国営/軍空港の脅威はerosion(emerging)/geopolで捕捉
evidence.disrupt: 蝕セクションは市場シェア・競争激化のみで技術代替のヒットなし。航空旅客需要に技術的代替なし=settled
evidence.geopol: メキシコ+ジャマイカの二国コンセッション。『the Mexican government may revoke one or more of our concessions at any time if it determines that doing so is in the public interest』(国家収用/rescate権)+軍所有の国営空港新設+ジャマイカ『Travel alerts issued by the U.S. Bureau of Consular Affairs...warn travelers about the risks of visiting Jamaica』(2024/1)=2(重)。ASRより単一空港集中は低いが二国地政学で相殺
evidence.nrr: 非開示のため既定105。航空会社集中: 上位4社が総収入の17.2/8.3/4.2/4.1%、『any consolidation among these...airline customers could increase our dependence on a smaller number of carriers』
evidence.p1: ROIC5年σ=10.3pt(二桁, COVID年込み: 2020 9.5%→2022 38.5%の大振幅)→50。COVID単発ショックによる歪みだが観光空港の構造的循環性を反映
evidence.p2: COVID時 営利2019 8.0→2020 3.8十億MXN=-53%DD。売上16.2→11.9(-27%)。深いDD側→50(観光/旅客業態の構造的脆弱性、-40〜-60%帯の下端寄り)
evidence.p3: 総借入48.0十億ベースのnde≈1.9-2.3(<2.5)→70。ジャマイカ取得+株主還元でネット純現金のASR(95)と異なり有意なレバレッジ
evidence.p4: accr=-9.6%(<0=保守的・現金創出的)は本来90方向。但し『In the past, we identified material weaknesses in our internal controls, and we cannot guarantee that additional material weaknesses will not arise』=過去の重要な不備を自認(定型文超えの実開示)。現行無限定意見はhitsで未確認。ASR(90)から一段下げ75。過去指摘は是正済推定・現行指摘のヒットなしのため≤50には至らず
evidence.f1: ROIIC(2022→2024)=ΔNOPAT0.7/ΔIC17.4≈4%<<メキシコWACC(高)。NIも2023 9.7→2024 8.9と減少、資産60→82十億の大型再投資が未回収→55。再投資率≥30%だが増分がサブWACCで非蓄積のため+5加点は差し控え。インフラは50年の長い懐妊期間で2-3年ROIIC測定は概念的に弱い旨注記
evidence.f2: 航空/観光TAM浸透。メキシコ低い一人当たり航空需要=長い滑走路だが数値不明。インフラ業態へのTAM浸透式当てはめは概念的に弱く保守側65(ASR同)
evidence.f3: R&D該当なし業態。シェア趨勢: FBO『increasing its market share from 38.3% to 42.8%』=片方+→75。航空会社集中は増悪懸念あるが実現した悪化ではなく-10不適用
evidence.f4: 非航空(商業)収入『24.2%, 28.6%, and 29.8% of our total revenues』で売上5%超かつ成長。非航空/旅客Ps.97.1→123.4→152.3も増勢=隣接事業成長→80

evidence.expiry: 『Compound patent expiry in the US for the semaglutide branded products - Ozempic, Rybelsus, and Wegovy - is 2032』+『The compound patent for Victoza has expired...The drug compound patent for Saxenda (liraglutide) has expired in all countries』→主力semaglutideは2032年特許崖・旧世代はバイオシミラー既出=期限型独占→yes
evidence.moatdecay: 『due to increased competition in both US and ex-US markets, Novo Nordisk has lost volume market share in the GLP-1 market places for both obesity and diabetes』+2032特許崖+『pricing pressure is expected to continue』→堀は縮小方向=yes
evidence.erosion: 『Novo Nordisk has lost volume market share in the GLP-1 market places for both obesity and diabetes』『average prices after rebates for the Novo Nordisk portfolio in 2025 in the United States declined』→現在進行の侵食=active
evidence.disrupt: 蝕セクションに技術代替のキーワードヒットなし。ただし『Novo Nordisk and Eli Lilly are the most significant companies...measured by market share』の二強競争が激化(シェア喪失・価格低下)。カテゴリー自体は成長継続だが競争構図流動的→unsettled
evidence.dom: 『Novo Nordisk and Eli Lilly are the most significant companies measured by market share』=GLP-1二強寡占(NVO単独シェアはLillyとの二分へ低下中)。『Obesity and Diabetes care...comprising more than 90% of sales』は売上構成であってシェアではない→寡占40-69%=70
evidence.irr_rep: 『a compound must first be proven to work by means of multiple clinical trials, which may require treatment of thousands of patients and could take years to complete』+『sustain strong patent protection』=複製は数年/$10B級で極困難→rep80。ただしLillyのtirzepatide等の代替が現存し患者移行可能→irr70(高摩擦だが唯一供給ではない)
evidence.dur: 特許(規制)+ペプチド大量製造のプロセス知(『there have been periodic supply constraints for certain products』が製造障壁の傍証)→規制/プロセス型の高堀。ただしLillyが同機序を実装済で絶対的スイッチングロックではない→85
evidence.geopol: 『pricing pressure is expected to continue in the future, driven by: increasing rebates in the commercial segment, the effect of payer consolidation』+『recognise revenue of USD 4.2 billion comprising the entire amount of provisions for 340B statutory discounts』=米薬価政策(IRA/340B/関税圧力)が中核フランチャイズに集中。ただし地理は米/EUCAN/EM/APAC/中国に分散→中=1
evidence.p1: ROIC5年σ=10.3pt(二桁)だが低下はIC急拡大(Catalent+設備投資)主因でopm41-44%安定→55
evidence.p2: 『revenue for the GLP-1 product Wegovy grew 36%』糖尿/肥満は非景気循環需要。2020 COVID期も営利52.5→54.1十億で増加=不況で営利低下せず→95
evidence.p4: accr=-3.1%(<0・OCF>NI=保守的)。『material weakness』ヒットは監査手続の定型記述で実指摘ではない。『ITEM 4A UNRESOLVED STAFF COMMENTS None』→90
evidence.f1: ROIIC 2023→25≒10%/2022→24≒30%(直近は前収益の製造能力投資で圧縮)+再投資率≥30%→65
evidence.f2: 『The growth in the number of people with obesity and diabetes and the increasing use of the GLP-1 drug category is driving』『expected to grow in the coming decades』=GLP-1の肥満TAM浸透は一桁%→85
evidence.f3: R&D『modestly expand upon the current expenditure level of around 15-17% of sales in research and development』(R&D対売上+)対『lost volume market share』(シェア−)=片方符号→75
evidence.f4: 中核が売上90%超(『more than 90% of sales』)。隣接の希少疾患/血友病(Concizumab/Alhemo新規承認)は5%超だが成長寄与は限定・育成段階→60
